arStrings.szText: For each active {c_important}Razor Wings{/c}, you gain {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%x|}]{/c} Movement Speed.

{c_important}Razor Wings{/c} hits increase your {c_important}Razor Wings{/c} damage by {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%x|]{/c} for {c_number}{SF_16}{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%x|]{/c}. Critical Strikes grant {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} stacks.
{c_important}Razor Wings{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_41} * 100|%|]{/c} chance to regain a Charge when hitting an enemy. Double this chance if you have an active {c_important}{u}Barrier{/u}{/c}.
{c_important}Razor Wings'{/c} Cooldown is {c_number}[{SF_39} * 100|%|]{/c} longer but it now regains all Charges at once.

When {c_important}Razor Wings{/c} hits an enemy for the first time, creates a {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c} that Sparks enemies for {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_LIGHTNING_DOT}{/c} damage. For each active {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c}, {c_important}Razor Wings{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_43 * 100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.
{c_important}Razor Wings{/c} last {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%|]{/c} longer and spiral outwards.

{c_important}Razor Wings{/c} becomes a {c_important}Gorilla{/c} Skill that deals Physical damage.

{c_important}Razor Wings{/c} generates {c_number}[SF_31]{/c} {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c} and fires a slow moving burst of energy that continually pulses, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_C}{/c} damage every {c_number}[SF_45|1|]{/c} seconds.
